summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a PDMR share sale under EU Market Abuse Regulation. Executive Chairman of Vodafone Germany and CEO of European Markets, Ahmed Essam, sold 2,500,000 ordinary shares at £1.20372 per share on 28 July 2026 on the London Stock Exchange. This is a routine insider transaction notification, not a corporate event. No strategic changes, board recommendations, deal terms, or special-situation catalysts are present. The filing complies with regulatory disclosure requirements and does not indicate a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special situation.
